description: CR 702.34a a granted flashback priced at the card's own mana cost is payable for that cost
note: Lier, Disciple of the Drowned grants each instant and sorcery card in alice's graveyard flashback at its own mana cost, read off the receiving card. Firebolt already prints Flashback {4}{R}, so it holds two flashback abilities whose costs share no reading, and alice has ONE Mountain: the granted {R} is payable and the printed {4}{R} is not. With ten lands both readings would exile Firebolt and deal 2, and nothing here would tell them apart. The cast offers both costs; paying the granted {R}, Firebolt deals alice 2 and is exiled rather than returning to the graveyard. Firebolt is aimed at alice so its damage reports which cast resolved; Lier is a legal target too.
